items: Active targeting of Siemens S7 PLCs across multiple U.S. critical infrastructure sectors is ongoing; adversaries are abusing S7comm (TCP/102) and Python snap7 tooling for reconnaissance and write operations. Immediate hardening, removal of internet exposure, and ICS-aware monitoring are required. Security Advisory

Edge gateways for remote access are under active exploitation: NetScaler ADC/Gateway zero-days (DTLS/SAML paths) and Citrix CVE-2026-88779 are confirmed in the wild; operators should patch, assess for pre-patch compromise, and lock down management planes. JPCERT/CC Alert CISA KEV
F5 BIG-IP APM OAuth configuration (CVE-2026-94127) is being exploited for unauthenticated RCE; patch or apply vendor iRule mitigations and rotate OAuth/SSO secrets. JPCERT/CC Advisory

CISA weekly bulletins highlight multiple OT-adjacent critical issues, including Advantech WISE-6610 LoRaWAN gateways, AVEVA Pipeline Integrity Monitor, eProsima Fast DDS, and GeoVision LPR cameras-prioritize segmentation and rapid remediation. CISA Bulletin

Possible maritime OT incident: U.S. authorities boarded a fully loaded oil supertanker after suspected access to propulsion controls; tighten shipboard OT network security and SATCOM hardening. View Article

Enterprise IT compromises still present material OT pivot risk: Kaspersky reports domain-wide impact via GPO abuse ("PAYLOAD" ransomware playbook) and CISA red-team assessments reinforce identity, ADCS, and IT/OT segmentation gaps. Supporting Report CISA Advisory
Direct OT risk: Active exploitation and scanning of Siemens S7 PLCs can enable process manipulation if TCP/102 and engineering access are insufficiently controlled. Security Advisory

Perimeter devices under fire: Multiple NetScaler and F5 BIG-IP APM flaws are exploited, providing adversaries with initial access and a path toward domain and OT jump hosts. JPCERT/CC (NetScaler) JPCERT/CC (F5 APM)
CISA KEV updates confirm in-the-wild exploitation of Citrix NetScaler CVE-2026-88779 and Zammad helpdesk vulnerabilities; rapidly patch and check for pre-patch compromise. CISA KEV CISA KEV
OT-adjacent vulnerabilities continue to emerge weekly (e.g., Advantech WISE-6610, AVEVA PIM, DDS/ROS2 components), requiring dedicated patch/segmentation programs. CISA Bulletin
Johnson Controls EasyIO Neo EC/CW controllers transmit credentials over HTTP in vulnerable builds; apply fixed firmware and enforce TLS. ICS Advisory
ShinyHunters disruption and arrests; ongoing data-theft/supply-chain risks despite takedown pressure. View Article View Article
China-aligned phishing (TA419) targeting U.S. AI policy experts via Microsoft AiTM and session-cookie theft, elevating strategic access risk. View Article
KillSec RaaS infrastructure disrupted by Europol; affiliates and common TTPs persist (ESXi lockers, data theft). View Article
MI5 alert on MSS-linked research funding via front entities (CGTRI/CAGT) suggests capacity building with potential CI implications. View Article
Citrix NetScaler CVE-2026-88779 (KEV) and related NetScaler RCEs; patch and assess for compromise. CISA KEV JPCERT/CC
F5 BIG-IP APM OAuth RCE (CVE-2026-94127) exploited; hotfixes and mitigations available. JPCERT/CC
Zammad helpdesk chained vulns (KEV) enable session fixation/privilege escalation; update to v7+, rotate secrets. CISA KEV Infosecurity
Cisco Secure Email Gateway SQLi RCE (CVE-2026-76461) actively exploited; upgrade AsyncOS immediately. JPCERT/CC

OT-adjacent devices: Advantech WISE-6610 (command injection), AVEVA PIMBoards (secrets exposure), eProsima Fast DDS (memory disclosure/crash), GeoVision LPR cameras (command injection/ONVIF replay). CISA Bulletin
Fortinet FortiMail path traversal (KEV) exploited; patch and restrict admin exposure. CISA KEV

Immediate gateway remediation: Patch NetScaler and F5 APM to fixed builds; restrict management exposure; assess for pre-patch compromise; rotate secrets/tokens. NetScaler Advisory F5 APM Advisory
PLC protections: Remove internet exposure, block TCP/102 at perimeters, enforce Siemens protection levels and disable PUT/GET where not required; deploy ICS IDS and baseline S7comm. CISA ICS Advisory
OT segmentation and jump host control: Strictly enforce IT/OT DMZs, MFA, and time-bound access for engineering; monitor OT bastion traffic.
Identity and AD hardening: Phishing-resistant MFA everywhere; reduce standing privileges; detect DCSync and constrain Kerberos delegation. CISA Guidance
Address OT-adjacent vulnerabilities (Advantech, AVEVA, DDS/ROS2, cameras): patch/upgrade, isolate management interfaces, rotate exposed credentials. CISA Bulletin
Johnson Controls EasyIO Neo: upgrade EC to V3.3b64 and CW to V3.3b26; disable HTTP; enforce TLS; monitor for ARP spoofing and cleartext traffic. ICS Advisory
Zammad/Citrix/Cisco/Fortinet KEV items: prioritize remediation and validate for compromise prior to patching; restrict admin planes; enable detailed logging. CISA KEV JPCERT/CC Cisco FortiMail KEV
Expect continued mass exploitation attempts against NetScaler and F5 APM; prioritize patch windows and temporary exposure reductions (ACLs, WAF rules, disabling risky profiles where feasible).
Increase ICS protocol monitoring for anomalous S7comm and unauthorized engineering connections; review vendor remote access accounts and session logs.
Run compromise assessments on Zammad and email gateways (Cisco/Fortinet); rotate admin and API credentials; invalidate sessions.
For maritime and transportation operators, validate SATCOM/remote vendor access controls and conduct drills for cyber-physical incident response.
